safety.en: This may be a danger sign. Go to the nearest health facility now, and ask someone to go with you. Open Emergency help in the app for who to call.
safety.sw: Hii inaweza kuwa dalili ya hatari. Nenda kituo cha afya kilicho karibu sasa, na muombe mtu akusindikize. Fungua Msaada wa dharura kwenye programu kuona wa kumpigia.

fact.en: Iron and folic acid tablets protect you and your baby from anaemia. Take one every day for the whole pregnancy. If they upset your stomach, take them with food and tell your nurse.
fact.sw: Vidonge vya madini chuma na folic vinakulinda wewe na mtoto dhidi ya upungufu wa damu. Meza kimoja kila siku katika ujauzito wote. Vikikusumbua tumbo, mezea na chakula na mwambie muuguzi.

fact.en: Clinic visits find problems like high blood pressure and anaemia before you feel them. WHO advises at least 8 antenatal contacts, even when you feel well.
fact.sw: Kliniki hugundua matatizo kama shinikizo la damu na upungufu wa damu kabla hujayahisi. WHO inashauri angalau mahudhurio 8 ya kliniki ya ujauzito, hata ukijisikia vizuri.

fact.en: Herbs to start or speed up labour can make the womb squeeze too hard and tear, and can harm the baby. Give birth at a health facility, where labour is watched safely.
fact.sw: Dawa za mitishamba za kuanzisha au kuharakisha uchungu zinaweza kufanya mji wa mimba ubane sana na kupasuka, na kumdhuru mtoto. Jifungulie kituo cha afya ambapo uchungu unaangaliwa kwa usalama.

fact.en: For the first 6 months a baby needs only breast milk: no water, tea, porridge or other milk, even in hot weather. Breast milk is already mostly water. Other drinks can bring diarrhoea.
fact.sw: Kwa miezi 6 ya kwanza mtoto anahitaji maziwa ya mama pekee: bila maji, chai, uji wala maziwa mengine, hata wakati wa joto. Maziwa ya mama yana maji ya kutosha. Vinywaji vingine vinaweza kuleta kuharisha.

fact.en: Keep the cord clean and dry and leave it uncovered. Put nothing on it unless your nurse gave you chlorhexidine. Dung, ash, oil or powder can cause a deadly infection.
fact.sw: Weka kitovu kisafi na kikavu, bila kufunika. Usiweke chochote isipokuwa chlorhexidine uliyopewa na muuguzi. Mavi, majivu, mafuta au poda vinaweza kuleta maambukizi hatari.

fact.en: The first yellow milk (colostrum) is the baby's first protection against illness. Give it to the baby within the first hour after birth. Do not throw it away.
fact.sw: Maziwa ya kwanza ya njano ni kinga ya kwanza ya mtoto dhidi ya magonjwa. Mpe mtoto ndani ya saa moja baada ya kuzaliwa. Usiyamwage.

fact.en: Vaccines are safe and protect babies from measles, polio, pneumonia and other killers. A small fever or a sore leg for a day or two is normal. Keep every vaccine date on the clinic card.
fact.sw: Chanjo ni salama na zinamlinda mtoto dhidi ya surua, polio, nimonia na magonjwa mengine hatari. Homa kidogo au mguu kuuma kwa siku moja au mbili ni kawaida. Fuata tarehe zote za chanjo kwenye kadi ya kliniki.

fact.en: No amount of alcohol is safe in pregnancy, and alcohol does not make more breast milk. It passes to the baby. Frequent breastfeeding is what makes more milk.
fact.sw: Hakuna kiasi cha pombe kilicho salama wakati wa ujauzito, na pombe haiongezi maziwa. Inamfikia mtoto. Kunyonyesha mara nyingi ndiko kunakoongeza maziwa.

fact.en: Do not give honey to a baby under 1 year old. It can carry germs that cause a serious illness (botulism) in babies.
fact.sw: Usimpe mtoto chini ya mwaka 1 asali. Inaweza kuwa na vijidudu vinavyoleta ugonjwa hatari kwa watoto wachanga.

fact.en: Eating less to keep the baby small is not safe: it can bring a weak baby and anaemia. Eat an extra small meal each day, including eggs, beans, fish, greens and fruit.
fact.sw: Kula kidogo ili mtoto awe mdogo si salama: kunaweza kuleta mtoto dhaifu na upungufu wa damu. Ongeza mlo mdogo mmoja kila siku, ikiwemo mayai, maharage, samaki, mboga za majani na matunda.

fact.en: Mothers living with HIV should keep taking their ARVs every day in pregnancy and while breastfeeding. This protects the mother and almost always keeps the baby free of HIV.
fact.sw: Mama anayeishi na VVU aendelee kumeza ARV kila siku wakati wa ujauzito na kunyonyesha. Hii inamlinda mama na karibu kila mara humkinga mtoto dhidi ya VVU.
